Matrix Calculator

Add, multiply, invert and transpose 2x2 and 3x3 matrices.

📖 How to use

  1. Choose 2x2 or 3x3 size.
  2. Type the values of matrices A and B.
  3. Press an operation: A+B, A−B, AxB, det, inverse or transpose.
  4. Results appear as a grid below, or an error if the operation is impossible.

❓ Frequently asked questions

How is the inverse computed?

By the adjugate-over-determinant formula. If the determinant is zero the matrix is singular (has no inverse) and the tool reports that instead of producing garbage.

Does it work for 4x4 or larger?

No. This tool handles 2×2 and 3×3 matrices; larger sizes would need a general elimination algorithm this page does not include.

Is AxB real matrix multiplication?

Yes — multiplication uses the standard row-times-column dot products, not element-wise multiplication.
